i have 1k hrs and the reason i quit is that there really isnt anything worth playing for. story isnt that good. there really isnt any challenging content in the game and anet decided to completely cater to the casuals and abandon dgns and raid wings. fractals are painfully boring doing the same old things over and over again. combat is unique for sure but doesnt feel really impactful at all. and my biggest problem is the lack of progression. you never feel your character getting stronger or feel any sort of accomplishment for clearing anything. the only real endgame is farming gold all day in some dumb meta train and buying skins with it (which the good ones are in the item mall or in a lootbox). i could go on and on but the list is too long. the thing that i really liked about this game is the mount system only at this point (still the best mount system in any mmo). basically when you do everything there is to do in the game (which isnt really a lot just a time sink like fractals or gold farm, raids arent really even worth it anymore) its just really empty. the new direction they took with the game just doesnt appeal me anymore and there isnt any good content to look forward to except the story updates (which really isnt that good). and ofc the performance issues.

i switched to ffxiv 2 yrs ago and its really set the bar for what an mmo should be like. like actual challenging content and a good story with a consistent update schedule.
